fields.label: GTIN
fields.definition: A Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is the 14 digit GS1 Identification Key used to identify products. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix followed by an Item Reference Number and a Check Digit. See https://www.gs1.org/gtin  for more details.
fields.tier_rationale: The GTIN identifies the model. It is stated explicitly rather than left to be read out of a SKU, because everything downstream — the Digital Link, the resolver, the passport itself — is keyed on it.

fields.label: batteryModelIdentifier
fields.tier_rationale: The model this article belongs to, where the regulation names one.

fields.label: Batch/Lot Identifier
fields.definition: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.
fields.tier_rationale: The lot. Class data describes the model; a lot is where a passport stops being the same for every item.

fields.label: Anode Active Material
fields.definition: Chemical composition of the anode active material (e.g., graphite, silicon, lithium titanate).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(a): anode materials are part of the detailed composition reserved for persons with a legitimate interest.

fields.label: Audit Body
fields.definition: Name of the organization that conducted the supply chain audit.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 51 third-party verification is what makes the Art. 52(3) public report credible, so naming the auditor is public like eubat:hasVerificationBody.

fields.label: Authorized Service Centers
fields.definition: URL to list of authorized service centers.
fields.tier_rationale: Service-center listings extend the Annex XIII(2)(b) spare-part/repair sourcing information addressed to professional repairers.

fields.label: Battery Passport Identifier
fields.definition: Unique identifier for the battery passport. Note: In this implementation, the primary identifier is the GS1 Digital Link (@id).
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 77(3): the unique passport identifier is the public entry point resolved from the QR code and cannot itself be gated.

fields.label: C-Rate
fields.definition: Nominal charge/discharge rate relative to capacity (e.g., 1C = full charge in 1 hour).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(p): the C-rate of the relevant cycle-life test is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: C-Rate Life Cycle Test
fields.definition: C-rate used for lifecycle testing.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(p): the C-rate applied in the cycle-life test is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Cadmium Symbol Required
fields.definition: Whether Cd symbol is required (cadmium > 0.002% by weight).
fields.tier_rationale: The Cd mark above 0.002 % cadmium is mandatory public labelling (Art. 13(6)/Annex VI Part B), so the flag restates on-battery information.

fields.label: Calculation Standard
fields.definition: Standard used for carbon footprint calculation (e.g., ISO 14067:2018).
fields.tier_rationale: The calculation standard is methodology metadata of the public CF declaration required to interpret the public figure (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Capacity Fade Threshold
fields.definition: Capacity fade percentage at which battery reaches end of rated cycle life (typically 80%).
fields.tier_rationale: The capacity-fade level that defines rated cycle life is part of the public declared durability ratings (Annex IV Part A), not battery-individual state.

fields.label: Capacity Threshold for Exhaustion
fields.definition: SOCE percentage threshold below which the battery is considered exhausted.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(k): the capacity threshold for exhaustion is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Geographic Scope
fields.definition: Geographic scope of the carbon footprint calculation.
fields.tier_rationale: The geographic scope is methodology metadata of the public CF declaration and must be visible for the public figure to be interpretable (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Study URL
fields.definition: URL to the full carbon footprint study document.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)(f): a web link to the public version of the CF study is mandatory public data; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: CAS Number
fields.definition: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number.
fields.tier_rationale: CAS numbers inside the material breakdown enable formulation reconstruction and belong to the Annex XIII(2)(a) detail tier; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Cathode Active Material
fields.definition: Chemical composition of the cathode active material (e.g., LiNiMnCoO2, LiFePO4, LiCoO2).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(a): cathode materials are part of the detailed composition reserved for persons with a legitimate interest.

fields.label: CE Marking Indicator
fields.definition: Whether the battery bears CE marking.
fields.tier_rationale: The CE marking is affixed visibly on the battery itself (Arts. 19-20), so the indicator restates public information.

fields.label: Cobalt Post-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.tier_rationale: Post-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 cobalt share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block.

fields.label: Cobalt Pre-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.tier_rationale: Pre-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 cobalt share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block.

fields.label: Cobalt Recycled Share
fields.definition: Total percentage of recycled cobalt content.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 8(1): the share of cobalt recovered from waste is a publicly documented percentage.

fields.label: Concentration
fields.definition: Concentration of the hazardous substance as percentage.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VI Part A discloses hazardous-substance presence publicly, but exact concentrations are Annex XIII(2)(a) composition detail; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Conflict Mineral Free
fields.definition: Declaration that the battery is free from conflict minerals.
fields.tier_rationale: A conflict-mineral-free declaration is a public-facing assertion of the due-diligence outcome (Arts. 47-52), analogous to oec:forcedLabourFreeAssertion (Public).

fields.label: Critical Raw Materials Statement
fields.definition: Statement about critical raw materials content per EU CRM Act.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(a) via Annex VI Part A: critical raw materials present above 0.1 % w/w must be stated publicly; only the per-material CRM flags inside the detailed composition are AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Dangerous Goods Packing Instructions
fields.definition: Packing instructions per IATA/ADR/IMDG regulations (e.g., PI965, PI966, PI967).
fields.tier_rationale: IATA/ADR/IMDG packing-instruction codes are standardised public transport-safety information any shipper must see (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Data Provider Certification
fields.definition: Certification or accreditation of the data provider.
fields.tier_rationale: Provider accreditation detail supports authority and auditor verification of the data pipeline; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Data Quality Assessment
fields.definition: Assessment of data quality and completeness (A-E rating).
fields.tier_rationale: A-E data-quality ratings qualify professional use of the passport data; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Depth of Discharge in Cycle Life Test
fields.definition: Depth of discharge (DoD) percentage used for cycle life testing.
fields.tier_rationale: The depth of discharge used in the cycle-life test is a public reference test condition that makes the public lifetime ratings interpretable (Annex XIII(1)(j)).

fields.label: Due Diligence Policy URL
fields.definition: URL to the company's supply chain due diligence policy.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 48(2) requires the due-diligence policy to be communicated, and the Art. 52(3) public report covers it, so the policy link is public.

fields.label: Due Diligence Report URL
fields.definition: URL to the supply chain due diligence report (MANDATORY).
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 52(3): operators must publicly report on their battery due-diligence policy, so the report link is public data.

fields.label: EC Number
fields.definition: European Community number (EINECS/ELINCS) for chemical substances.
fields.tier_rationale: EC numbers inside the material breakdown are formulation-level identifiers under Annex XIII(2)(a); dpp-core and eutex serve the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Electrolyte Composition
fields.definition: Chemical composition of the electrolyte.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(a): electrolyte materials are part of the detailed composition reserved for persons with a legitimate interest.

fields.label: Electrolyte Type
fields.definition: Type of electrolyte used (e.g., liquid organic, polymer gel, solid-state ceramic).
fields.tier_rationale: The electrolyte type qualifies the Annex XIII(2)(a) electrolyte detail block; the public chemistry disclosure is already covered by eubat:hasBatteryChemistry.

fields.label: Estimated Impact
fields.definition: Estimated impact of the temperature excursion on battery health.
fields.tier_rationale: The estimated health impact of a temperature excursion feeds the Annex VII SoH evaluation for the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Event Date
fields.tier_rationale: When a negative event occurred is Annex VII Part B accident history evaluated by the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Exhaustion Threshold
fields.definition: SOCE percentage threshold for battery exhaustion.
fields.tier_rationale: Duplicate expression of the public exhaustion threshold (Annex XIII(1)(k)); tier kept identical to eubat:capacityThresholdForExhaustion.

fields.label: Expected Cycle Life
fields.definition: Expected number of full charge-discharge cycles under reference test conditions.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(j): expected lifetime expressed in cycles under reference test conditions is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Expected Lifetime (Years)
fields.definition: Expected calendar lifetime under normal operating conditions, in years.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(j): expected calendar lifetime is a public declared durability value; eutex serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Expected Number of Cycles
fields.definition: Manufacturer-declared expected number of full cycles.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(j): the manufacturer-declared expected number of full cycles is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Expected Remaining Cycles
fields.definition: Estimated remaining charge-discharge cycles.
fields.tier_rationale: Estimated remaining cycles derive from the AuthorizedOnly SoH state and serve the Art. 14 expected-lifetime evaluation, unlike the public declared cycle-life rating.

fields.label: Expected Remaining Lifetime (Months)
fields.definition: Estimated remaining useful lifetime in months.
fields.tier_rationale: Estimated remaining lifetime derives from the AuthorizedOnly SoH state and serves the Art. 14 expected-lifetime evaluation, unlike the public declared lifetime rating.

fields.label: Exposure Duration (Minutes)
fields.definition: Duration of temperature exposure in minutes.
fields.tier_rationale: Per-excursion exposure duration is the granular form of the Annex VII Part B extreme-temperature history served to the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Exposure End Time
fields.definition: End time of the temperature exposure.
fields.tier_rationale: Per-excursion timing is the granular form of the Annex VII Part B extreme-temperature history served to the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Extended Warranty Available
fields.definition: Whether extended warranty is available for purchase.
fields.tier_rationale: Availability of an extended warranty is purchase-decision information for consumers, alongside the public Annex XIII(1)(m) warranty period.

fields.label: Extinguishing Agent
fields.definition: Recommended fire extinguishing agent for the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VI Part A/Annex XIII(1)(a): the usable extinguishing agent must be publicly stated — first responders cannot authenticate before acting.

fields.label: Facility Identifier
fields.definition: Unique identifier of the manufacturing facility (recommended: GS1 GLN). Sits on the oec:FacilityInformation referenced by eubat:hasManufacturingPlace.
fields.tier_rationale: Internal facility identifiers (GLN of the plant) map the physical supply chain for notified bodies and surveillance — the public sees the manufacturing place itself via eubat:hasManufacturingPlace; matches oec:facilityId (Restricted).

fields.label: Functional Unit
fields.definition: Functional unit for carbon footprint measurement (e.g., 1 kWh of total energy throughput).
fields.tier_rationale: The functional unit is methodology metadata of the public CF declaration required to interpret the public figure (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Absolute Carbon Footprint
fields.definition: Total carbon footprint in kg CO2e (not normalized per kWh).
fields.tier_rationale: The non-normalised total CF only restates the public Art. 7/Annex XIII(1)(c) figure in absolute terms and stays in the public CF block.

fields.label: Has Battery
fields.definition: Links a product to one or more batteries it contains or is equipped with. Use this property to associate electric vehicles, power tools, energy storage systems, or any other product with its battery or batteries. Defined as subproperty of schema:hasPart for semantic web interoperability.
fields.tier_rationale: The product-to-battery link only enables passport discovery from the containing product and reveals no data beyond what each linked passport tier gates itself (Art. 77(2)).

fields.label: Battery Chemistry
fields.definition: The electrochemical system of the battery including cathode, anode, and electrolyte composition.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(a) via Annex VI Part A: the general battery chemistry is public passport data — only the detailed cathode/anode/electrolyte composition moves to Annex XIII(2)(a).

fields.label: Battery Mass
fields.definition: Net mass of the battery. Use unitCode 'KGM' (kilogram) per UN/CEFACT Rec 20. Sub-property of gs1:netWeight to keep GS1-first.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(a) via Annex VI Part A: the weight of the battery is public labelling information.

fields.label: Capacity Fade
fields.definition: Capacity degradation as a percentage of rated capacity, computed as ((rated − remaining) / rated) × 100. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: measured capacity fade is battery-individual degradation state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Capacity Throughput
fields.definition: Cumulative capacity throughput. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'AMP_HR'.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: cumulative capacity throughput is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Declaration
fields.definition: Carbon footprint declaration for the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)/Annex XIII(1)(c): the carbon footprint declaration accompanies the battery publicly; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint - Distribution
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)(e): the CF share of the distribution stage is part of the public declaration; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Performance Class
fields.definition: Performance class for carbon footprint (A-E).
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(2)/Annex XIII(1)(c): the CF performance class is public labelling information.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint - Production
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)(e): the CF share of the production stage is part of the public declaration; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint - Raw Material Extraction
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)(e): the CF share of the raw-material acquisition stage is part of the public declaration.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint - Recycling
fields.definition: Carbon footprint share from end-of-life/recycling phase (may be negative credit).
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)(e): the CF share of the end-of-life/recycling stage is part of the public declaration.

fields.label: Carbon Footprint Total
fields.definition: Total lifecycle carbon footprint in kg CO2e per kWh.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 7(1)(d)/Annex XIII(1)(c): the lifecycle CF per kWh is the headline public figure of the declaration; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Cell Type
fields.definition: Physical form factor of the battery cells.
fields.tier_rationale: The cell form factor (cylindrical/prismatic/pouch) is catalogue-level product data with no confidentiality content, aligned with the public Annex XIII(1) identification block (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Certified Usable Energy
fields.definition: The certified usable energy capacity of the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1): the certified usable battery energy is a public rated value against which SoCE is later judged.

fields.label: Compliance Status
fields.definition: Current regulatory compliance status of the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Compliance assertions exist to be shown to buyers and authorities alike, mirroring the public EU declaration of conformity (Annex XIII(1)(r)); dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Component Location
fields.definition: Component location in the battery (cathode, anode, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: Where a material sits in the battery (cathode/anode/electrolyte) is Annex XIII(2)(a) composition detail for professional users.

fields.label: Current Self-Discharging Rate
fields.definition: Current rate of self-discharge of the battery. Use unitCode 'P1' (percent) per UN/CEFACT Rec 20; period typically per month.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: the current self-discharge rate is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Cycle Count
fields.definition: Number of full charge-discharge cycles. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'C62' (count).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: the number of charge-discharge cycles is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Dismantling and Removal Information
fields.definition: Reference to the dismantling and removal instructions document required by EU Battery Regulation Annex VIII §B.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(c): dismantling information including disassembly sequences and removal instructions is reserved for persons with a legitimate interest.

fields.label: Dismantling Documents
fields.definition: Documents supporting battery dismantling per DIN DKE SPEC 99100.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(c): the exploded diagrams and supporting documents ARE the dismantling information reserved for the legitimate-interest audience (structured per DIN DKE SPEC 99100).

fields.label: Dismantling Instructions
fields.definition: Reference to dismantling instructions document for safe disassembly of the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(c): dismantling instructions are reserved for persons with a legitimate interest; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Estimated Dismantling Time
fields.definition: Estimated time required for safe battery dismantling.
fields.tier_rationale: Estimated dismantling time is planning detail for the Annex XIII(2)(c) dismantling audience (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: End of Life Information
fields.definition: Information required for safe handling, dismantling, recycling, and disposal at end of battery life.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(s): information on prevention and management of waste batteries per Art. 74(1)(a)-(f) is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Energy Throughput
fields.definition: Cumulative energy throughput. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'KWH'.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: cumulative energy throughput is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: EU Declaration of Conformity
fields.definition: The EU Declaration of Conformity for this battery, modelled as a cccev:Evidence supporting the EU Battery Regulation requirements. Carries the document URL (eubat:declarationOfConformity), the declaration ID (eubat:euDeclarationOfConformityId), and the notified body that signed off (eubat:hasNotifiedBody).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(r): the EU declaration of conformity is public battery-passport data; eutex serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Event Location
fields.tier_rationale: Where a negative event occurred is Annex VII Part B accident-history detail for the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Event Type
fields.definition: Type of negative event.
fields.tier_rationale: The kind of negative event (thermal event, deep discharge, ...) is Annex VII Part B accident history for the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Evolution of Self Discharge
fields.definition: Change in self-discharge rate. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: the evolution of self-discharge is battery-individual degradation state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Expected Lifetime
fields.definition: Manufacturer-declared expected service life of the battery. Use unitCode 'MON' (months) or 'ANN' (years) per UN/CEFACT Rec 20.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(j): the expected battery lifetime under reference conditions is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Expected Lifetime Capacity Throughput
fields.definition: Total capacity throughput expected over battery lifetime in Ah. Use unitCode 'AMH' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex IV Part A/Annex XIII(1)(j): the declared lifetime capacity throughput is a public durability rating.

fields.label: Expected Lifetime Energy Throughput
fields.definition: Total energy throughput expected over battery lifetime in kWh. Use unitCode 'KWH' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex IV Part A/Annex XIII(1)(j): the declared lifetime energy throughput is a public durability rating.

fields.label: Hazard Class
fields.definition: CLP Regulation hazard classification.
fields.tier_rationale: CLP hazard classes drive mandatory public label elements and qualify the public hazardous-substances disclosure; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Hazardous Substances
fields.definition: Hazardous substances present in the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(a) via Annex VI Part A: hazardous substances contained in the battery beyond Hg/Cd/Pb must be disclosed publicly; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Incident Severity
fields.definition: Severity level of the incident.
fields.tier_rationale: Severity grading qualifies the Annex VII Part B accident record for repurposers and recyclers judging reusability.

fields.label: Initial Capacity
fields.definition: Measured capacity at commissioning (ILMD).
fields.tier_rationale: The capacity measured at commissioning (ILMD) is the battery-individual SoH baseline used by the Art. 14/Annex VII audience — the declared rating stays public separately.

fields.label: Initial Energy
fields.definition: Measured energy at commissioning (ILMD).
fields.tier_rationale: The energy measured at commissioning (ILMD) is the battery-individual SoH baseline used by the Art. 14/Annex VII audience — the declared rating stays public separately.

fields.label: Initial Internal Resistance
fields.definition: Initial internal resistance at commissioning in Ohms. Use unitCode 'OHM' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(o): internal cell/pack resistance as a declared parameter is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Internal Resistance
fields.definition: Battery internal resistance in Ohms. Use unitCode 'OHM' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: The current measured internal resistance is Annex VII health state — only the initial declared value (eubat:hasInitialInternalResistance) is public under Annex XIII(1)(o).

fields.label: Internal Resistance Increase
fields.definition: Percentage increase in internal resistance. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: measured resistance increase is battery-individual degradation state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Labels
fields.definition: Labels and markings on the battery per Annex VI.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(q): the labels and markings required by Art. 13(3)-(4) and their meaning are public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Manufacturing Place
fields.definition: Location where the battery was manufactured. A oec:FacilityInformation (subClassOf gs1:Place) carrying GLN, certifications, and facility-specific identifiers.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(a) via Annex VI Part A: the place of manufacturing (geographical location of the plant) is public — only the internal facility identifier is tiered separately (see eubat:facilityIdentifier).

fields.label: Material Composition
fields.definition: Materials used in battery construction with their percentages, locations, and critical raw material status. Aligned with schema:hasPart for semantic web interoperability.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(a): the per-material breakdown with percentages is the detailed composition reserved for persons with a legitimate interest; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Material Recovery Targets
fields.definition: Recovery rate targets or achievements for specific materials.
fields.tier_rationale: Recovery targets restate the regulation's own Annex XII objectives and support the public Art. 74 end-of-life information.

fields.label: Maximum Charging Current
fields.definition: Maximum allowed charging current in Amperes. Use unitCode 'AMP' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Charging limits are safety-relevant operating boundaries in the spirit of the public power-capability limits of Annex XIII(1)(i) (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Maximum Charging Power
fields.definition: Maximum allowed charging power in kW. Use unitCode 'KWT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Charging limits are safety-relevant operating boundaries in the spirit of the public power-capability limits of Annex XIII(1)(i) (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Maximum Discharging Current
fields.definition: Maximum allowed discharging current in Amperes. Use unitCode 'AMP' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Discharging limits are safety-relevant operating boundaries in the spirit of the public power-capability limits of Annex XIII(1)(i) (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Maximum Discharging Power
fields.definition: Maximum allowed discharging power in kW. Use unitCode 'KWT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Discharging limits are safety-relevant operating boundaries in the spirit of the public power-capability limits of Annex XIII(1)(i) (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Maximum Permitted Battery Power
fields.definition: Maximum permitted battery power (single declared value). Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'WTT' (watt) or 'KWT' (kW), UN/CEFACT Rec 20.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(i): the maximum permitted battery power is a public power-capability limit.

fields.label: Maximum Voltage
fields.definition: Maximum allowable voltage when fully charged, in Volts (V). Use unitCode 'VLT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(h): the maximum voltage boundary is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Minimum Voltage
fields.definition: Minimum allowable voltage to prevent deep discharge damage, in Volts (V). Use unitCode 'VLT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(h): the minimum voltage boundary is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Negative Events
fields.definition: Log of safety- or performance-relevant negative events recorded over the battery lifetime: accident, thermal event, deep discharge, short circuit, etc. Range is the existing eubat:NegativeEvent class.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: information on accidents and other negative events is battery-individual history for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Nominal Voltage
fields.definition: Nominal operating voltage of the battery pack in Volts (V). Use unitCode 'VLT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(h): nominal voltage (with its temperature boundaries) is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Notified Body
fields.definition: The notified body that performed the conformity assessment for this battery. Modelled as cv:PublicOrganisation (SEMICeu CPOV) carrying its number, name, and contact details.
fields.tier_rationale: The structured conformity-assessment-body record serves verification workflows; its number already appears on the public DoC document, and eucpr serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Economic Operator Information
fields.definition: Non-identifier metadata of the economic operator responsible for the battery (Art. 38): name, postal address, contact point. The operator's identifier is carried separately by eubat:operatorIdentifier so the two can be exposed at different access levels (v1.3 separates them: identifier is restricted to authorities, information remains public).
fields.tier_rationale: Detailed operator records (Art. 38: name, address, contact point) serve surveillance and professional traceability; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Operator Role
fields.definition: Role of the economic operator (manufacturer, importer, distributor, etc.).
fields.tier_rationale: The operator's supply-chain role maps responsibility chains for authorities and professional users; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Original Power Capability
fields.definition: Original power capability at specific SoC levels (80% and 20%).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(i): original power capability (with limits and temperature boundaries) is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Power Capability at 20% SoC
fields.definition: Current power capability at 20% state of charge. Use unitCode 'KWT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Current power capability at 20 % SoC is a measured expression of the Annex VII remaining-power-capability state for the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Power Capability at 80% SoC
fields.definition: Current power capability at 80% state of charge. Use unitCode 'KWT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Current power capability at 80 % SoC is a measured expression of the Annex VII remaining-power-capability state for the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Power Fade
fields.definition: Power capability degradation as a percentage of original power capability, computed as ((original − remaining) / original) × 100. Use unitCode 'P1' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: measured power fade is battery-individual degradation state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Rated Capacity
fields.definition: Rated capacity in Ampere-hours (Ah). Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'AMH'.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(g): the rated capacity is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Rated Energy
fields.definition: Rated energy in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'KWH'.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(g)/Annex IV Part A: rated energy is a declared capacity parameter in the public performance block.

fields.label: Rated Maximum Power
fields.definition: Rated maximum power output in kW. Use unitCode 'KWT' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(i)/Annex IV Part A: rated power capability is public passport data.

fields.label: Recycled Content
fields.definition: Declaration of recycled material content with breakdown by material type and pre/post-consumer sources.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 8/Annex XIII(1)(e): recycled-content documentation for cobalt, lithium, nickel and lead is public passport data; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Remaining Capacity
fields.definition: Current maximum capacity. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'AMP_HR'.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: remaining capacity is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Remaining Energy
fields.definition: Current maximum energy. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'KWH'.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: remaining energy is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Remaining Power Capability
fields.definition: Current power capability measurements at various SoC levels.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: remaining power capability is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Remaining Round Trip Efficiency
fields.definition: Current round trip energy efficiency. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: remaining round-trip efficiency is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Remaining Usable Energy
fields.definition: The current remaining usable energy capacity.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: remaining usable energy is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Repurposing Entity
fields.definition: Organization that performed the repurposing.
fields.tier_rationale: The operator that repurposed the battery is responsibility-chain detail for the Art. 59 audience and authorities, like oec:hasOperatorInformation.

fields.label: Responsible Sourcing Standard
fields.definition: Standard followed for responsible sourcing.
fields.tier_rationale: Naming the due-diligence scheme followed (Art. 50 recognised schemes) is part of the public policy communication.

fields.label: Round Trip Efficiency Fade
fields.definition: Degradation of round trip efficiency, computed as ((initial RTE − remaining RTE) / initial RTE) × 100. Use unitCode 'P1' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: measured efficiency fade is battery-individual degradation state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Self Discharge Rate
fields.definition: Current self-discharge rate. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent per month).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: the current self-discharge rate is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Spare Part Sources
fields.definition: Sources for spare parts for the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(b): sources for spare parts are reserved for persons with a legitimate interest.

fields.label: State of Certified Energy
fields.definition: SOCE ratio of remaining to certified usable energy. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: SoCE is battery-individual health state for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: State of Charge
fields.definition: Current charge level as percentage. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'P1' (percent).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part A: state of charge is battery-individual BMS data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: State of Health
fields.definition: Battery state of health as percentage of original capacity. Use unitCode 'P1' (UN/CEFACT Rec 20).
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 14(1)/Annex VII: state-of-health data is BMS-readable for the legitimate-interest audience, not the general public.

fields.label: Substance Location
fields.definition: Location of the hazardous substance in the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Where a hazardous substance sits in the battery is dismantling/processing detail for waste operators (Annex XIII(2)); dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Supplier Contact
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(b): contact details of spare-part sources are part of the legitimate-interest spare-parts information.

fields.label: Supply Chain Due Diligence
fields.definition: Supply chain due diligence information per Art. 39.
fields.tier_rationale: The container must be publicly reachable so the Art. 52(3) public report link inside it is servable; sensitive members carry their own stricter tiers.

fields.label: Technical Specifications
fields.definition: Technical performance specifications including capacity, voltage, power, and lifetime parameters.
fields.tier_rationale: Container for the Annex IV Part A rated performance and durability parameters that Annex XIII(1)(g)-(p) makes public.

fields.label: Temperature Range - Charging
fields.definition: Allowable temperature range during charging.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(h)-(i) publish voltage/power values together with their temperature boundaries, so the charging temperature window is public rating data.

fields.label: Temperature Range - Discharging
fields.definition: Allowable temperature range during discharging.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(h)-(i) publish voltage/power values together with their temperature boundaries, so the discharging temperature window is public rating data.

fields.label: Temperature Range - Idle State
fields.definition: Temperature range for the battery in idle state.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(l): the temperature range the battery can withstand when not in use is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Temperature Range - Storage
fields.definition: Allowable temperature range for battery storage.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(l): storage temperature boundaries are public data the end user needs for safe keeping of the battery.

fields.label: Third Party Verification
fields.definition: Third-party verification details for the carbon footprint declaration.
fields.tier_rationale: Third-party verification details are what make the public CF declaration checkable, mirroring the public verification terms in dpp-core (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Verification Body
fields.definition: Organization that performed the third-party verification.
fields.tier_rationale: Naming the third-party verifier is what makes the public CF declaration checkable; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Incident Report URL
fields.definition: URL to the full incident report.
fields.tier_rationale: Full incident reports function as safety submissions evaluated by market surveillance authorities (Chapter IX), beyond the Annex VII accident summary served to the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Information on Collection
fields.definition: URL to information about collection points and procedures.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 74(1)(b)/Annex XIII(1)(s): collection points and take-back information must reach end users publicly.

fields.label: Initial Self Discharge
fields.definition: Initial self-discharge rate as percentage per month.
fields.tier_rationale: The initial (declared) self-discharge rate belongs to the public Annex IV Part A performance ratings — only its measured evolution is BMS state data under Annex XIII(4).

fields.label: Inspector ID
fields.definition: Identifier of the inspector who assessed the incident.
fields.tier_rationale: The assessing inspector's identifier is operational bookkeeping of the Annex VII Part B accident record; it names a person and has no public function.

fields.label: Is Critical Raw Material
fields.definition: Whether this material is on the EU Critical Raw Materials list.
fields.tier_rationale: Per-material CRM flags serve recyclers' recovery obligations inside the Annex XIII(2)(a) composition detail — the public CRM disclosure is eubat:criticalRawMaterialsStatement; dpp-core serves the same name AuthorizedOnly.

fields.label: Is Substance of Concern
fields.definition: Whether this material is a Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) per REACH.
fields.tier_rationale: The per-material SVHC flag qualifies rows of the Annex XIII(2)(a) composition detail — public presence disclosure is already served by eubat:hasHazardousSubstances.

fields.label: Language Code
fields.definition: ISO 639-1 language code.
fields.tier_rationale: Language codes are rendering metadata with no confidentiality content; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Last Data Update
fields.definition: Timestamp of the last update to the battery passport data.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 77(7) requires the passport to stay up to date, so the update timestamp is interpretation metadata every audience needs; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Lead Post-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.definition: Percentage of the lead content recovered from post-consumer waste, expressed on the same basis as the lithium, cobalt and nickel post-consumer shares. Voluntary breakdown of the aggregate eubat:leadRecycledShare.
fields.tier_rationale: Voluntary post-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 lead share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block with the other three metals.

fields.label: Lead Pre-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.definition: Percentage of the lead content recovered from pre-consumer (manufacturing) waste, expressed on the same basis as the lithium, cobalt and nickel pre-consumer shares. Voluntary breakdown of the aggregate eubat:leadRecycledShare.
fields.tier_rationale: Voluntary pre-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 lead share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block with the other three metals.

fields.label: Lead Recycled Share
fields.definition: Total percentage of recycled lead content (combined pre- and post-consumer). The EU Battery Regulation does not require a pre/post split for lead, in contrast to lithium, cobalt, nickel; v1.3 of the BatteryPass-Ready longlist consolidated the two former v1.2 attributes (#43 + #47) into this single share.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 8(1): the share of lead recovered from waste is a publicly documented percentage (no pre/post split required for lead).

fields.label: Lead Symbol Required
fields.definition: Whether Pb symbol is required (lead > 0.004% by weight).
fields.tier_rationale: The Pb mark above 0.004 % lead is mandatory public labelling (Art. 13(6)/Annex VI Part B), so the flag restates on-battery information.

fields.label: Lifetime Reference Test
fields.definition: URL or reference to the standard test used for lifetime determination.
fields.tier_rationale: The reference test standard behind the public lifetime ratings must be public for those ratings to be checkable (Annex XIII(1)(j)).

fields.label: Lithium Post-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.tier_rationale: Post-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 lithium share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block.

fields.label: Lithium Pre-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.tier_rationale: Pre-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 lithium share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block.

fields.label: Lithium Recycled Share
fields.definition: Total percentage of recycled lithium content.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 8(1): the share of lithium recovered from waste is a publicly documented percentage.

fields.label: Manufacturer Identifier
fields.definition: Unique identifier of the battery manufacturer (recommended: GS1 GLN). Sits on the oec:OperatorInformation that plays the Manufacturer role; distinct OperatorInformation instances may identify different operators (manufacturer vs. importer vs. distributor).
fields.tier_rationale: The manufacturer's internal operator identifier serves authority cross-checks; public identification is already served by the Annex VI Part A manufacturer information.

fields.label: Material Supplier
fields.definition: Name or identifier of the material supplier.
fields.tier_rationale: Supplier identities are detailed supply-chain data behind the public Art. 52(3) report summary and serve the legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Measurement Certificate URL
fields.definition: URL to the measurement certificate document.
fields.tier_rationale: The certificate documents an individual SoH/SOCE measurement and accompanies the Annex VII data served to the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Next Scheduled Measurement
fields.definition: Date of next scheduled SOCE measurement.
fields.tier_rationale: SOCE measurement scheduling is maintenance bookkeeping for the Art. 14 SoH audience, not consumer information.

fields.label: Nickel Post-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.tier_rationale: Post-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 nickel share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block.

fields.label: Nickel Pre-Consumer Recycled Share
fields.tier_rationale: Pre-consumer breakdown of the public Art. 8 nickel share per the recycled-content calculation methodology; stays in the public block.

fields.label: Nickel Recycled Share
fields.definition: Total percentage of recycled nickel content.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 8(1): the share of nickel recovered from waste is a publicly documented percentage.

fields.label: Number of Cells
fields.definition: Total number of cells in the battery pack.
fields.tier_rationale: Cell count is coarse pack-architecture catalogue data, not the detailed composition reserved by Annex XIII(2)(a) (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Number of Deep Discharge Events
fields.definition: Cumulative count of deep-discharge events recorded over the battery lifetime.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(4) via Annex VII: the count of deep-discharge events is battery-individual negative-event data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience, matching eubat:hasNegativeEvents.

fields.label: Number of Full Cycles
fields.definition: Cumulative number of full equivalent cycles the battery has completed.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: full equivalent cycles are battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Number of Modules
fields.definition: Number of modules in the battery pack.
fields.tier_rationale: Module count is coarse pack-architecture catalogue data, not the detailed composition reserved by Annex XIII(2)(a) (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Economic Operator Identifier
fields.definition: Unique identifier of the economic operator (recommended: GS1 GLN, ESPR EOID per Article 77). Sits on the oec:OperatorInformation referenced by eubat:hasOperatorInformation.
fields.tier_rationale: The economic-operator identifier (GLN/EOID) serves customs and market-surveillance cross-checks, matching oec:economicOperatorId (AuthorizedOnly).

fields.label: Power Capability Ratio
fields.definition: Ratio of rated power to rated energy (W/Wh).
fields.tier_rationale: Annex IV Part A/Annex XIII(1)(i): the ratio between nominal allowed power (W) and battery energy (Wh) is a public declared parameter.

fields.label: Previous Applications
fields.definition: Description of previous use cases if battery is repurposed.
fields.tier_rationale: The battery's use history informs the Art. 59/Annex XIII(4) legitimate-interest audience evaluating repurposed batteries.

fields.label: Putting Into Service
fields.definition: Date when the battery was first put into service.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: the date of putting into service is battery-individual lifecycle data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Recommended Action
fields.definition: Recommended follow-up action after the incident.
fields.tier_rationale: Post-incident follow-up instructions address the professional handlers of the battery, not the general public (Annex VII Part B context).

fields.label: Recyclability Rate
fields.definition: Percentage of the battery (by weight) that can be recycled.
fields.tier_rationale: The recyclable fraction is consumer-facing circularity information in the public Art. 74 end-of-life block; dpp-core and euelec serve the same name Public.

fields.label: Renewable Content
fields.definition: Percentage of renewable content in the battery.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(f): the share of renewable content is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Renewable Content Share
fields.definition: Percentage of this material derived from renewable sources.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(f): the per-material renewable content share expresses the public renewable-content disclosure.

fields.label: Repurposing Date
fields.definition: Date when the battery was repurposed.
fields.tier_rationale: Repurposing lifecycle bookkeeping belongs to the Art. 59 status history evaluated by the legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Repurposing Guidelines
fields.definition: URL to guidelines for battery repurposing.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 59(1): information relevant for repurposing and preparation for repurposing is granted to legitimate-interest operators, not the general public.

fields.label: Repurposing Potential
fields.definition: Assessment of battery suitability for second-life applications.
fields.tier_rationale: Second-life suitability assessments serve repurposers and remanufacturers under Art. 59, based on the AuthorizedOnly SoH data.

fields.label: Resistance Increase Threshold
fields.definition: Internal resistance increase percentage at which battery reaches end of rated cycle life.
fields.tier_rationale: The resistance-increase level that defines rated cycle life is part of the public declared durability ratings (Annex IV Part A), not battery-individual state.

fields.label: Result of Test Report URL
fields.definition: URL to test report results.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(3): results of test reports proving compliance are accessible only to notified bodies, market surveillance authorities and the Commission.

fields.label: Risk Assessment Summary
fields.definition: Summary of the supply chain risk assessment findings.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 52(3): the public due-diligence report summarises identified supply-chain risks and their mitigation, so the summary (not the underlying data) is public.

fields.label: Round Trip Efficiency
fields.definition: Initial round-trip energy efficiency as percentage.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(n): the initial round-trip energy efficiency is public battery-passport data.

fields.label: Round Trip Efficiency at 50% Cycle Life
fields.definition: Expected round trip efficiency at 50% of rated cycle life.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(n): round-trip efficiency expected at 50 % of cycle life is a public declared value.

fields.label: Round-Trip Energy Efficiency
fields.definition: Current round-trip energy efficiency on the 0-1 decimal scale (0.92 = 92%).
fields.tier_rationale: The current measured round-trip efficiency is Annex VII health state — only the initial declared value (eubat:roundTripEfficiency) is public.

fields.label: Safety Instructions
fields.definition: URL to general safety instructions document.
fields.tier_rationale: General safe-use and handling instructions address end users (Art. 74(1)(f)); only dismantling-specific safety measures are reserved to Annex XIII(2)(d).

fields.label: Safety Instructions for Dismantling
fields.definition: URL to specific safety requirements for battery dismantling.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(d): safety measures for the dismantling process address trained professionals, not the general public.

fields.label: Safety Measures
fields.definition: End-of-life handling safety guidance: short text or URL fragment.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(d): end-of-life handling safety measures accompany the dismantling information for the legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Separate Collection
fields.definition: URL to information about separate collection requirements.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 74(1)(a)/Annex XIII(1)(s): end users' role in separate collection is public waste-prevention information.

fields.label: Separate Collection Symbol URL
fields.definition: URL to the crossed-out wheeled bin symbol.
fields.tier_rationale: The crossed-out wheeled bin is the mandatory separate-collection symbol printed on every battery (Art. 13(5)/Annex VI Part B).

fields.label: Proper Shipping Name
fields.definition: UN proper shipping name for dangerous goods transport.
fields.tier_rationale: The UN proper shipping name appears on public transport documents and package markings (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Spare Parts
fields.definition: Part numbers of the battery's components, listed as the spare-part component identifiers available from this supplier.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(2)(b): part numbers for components are reserved for persons with a legitimate interest.

fields.label: Substance CAS Number
fields.definition: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number for the hazardous substance.
fields.tier_rationale: The CAS number only identifies WHICH hazardous substance is publicly disclosed under Annex VI Part A — unlike eubat:casNumber it carries no formulation context.

fields.label: Substance EC Number
fields.definition: European Community number for the hazardous substance.
fields.tier_rationale: The EC number only identifies WHICH hazardous substance is publicly disclosed under Annex VI Part A — unlike eubat:ecNumber it carries no formulation context.

fields.label: Supply Chain Index
fields.definition: Optional supply chain sustainability index score.
fields.tier_rationale: A proprietary supply-chain score is detailed chain data behind the public Art. 52(3) report summary, for the legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Supply Chain Mapping Available
fields.definition: Whether detailed supply chain mapping is available.
fields.tier_rationale: The boolean only advertises that detailed mapping exists; the mapping data itself stays with the legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Temperature Excursion Report URL
fields.definition: URL to the temperature excursion report.
fields.tier_rationale: The excursion report documents condition history for downstream evaluators (repurposers, recyclers) under Art. 14, unlike authority incident submissions.

fields.label: Test Report Number
fields.definition: Identifier of the test report.
fields.tier_rationale: The report identifier belongs to the Annex XIII(3) compliance test reports and has no function outside the authority audience.

fields.label: Third Party Assurances URL
fields.definition: URL to third party verification or assurances.
fields.tier_rationale: Third-party assurance links substantiate the public due-diligence claims and are public by function; dpp-core serves the same name Public.

fields.label: Time Spent Charging During Extreme Temperatures Above Boundary
fields.definition: Cumulative time the battery spent charging above the upper temperature boundary, in minutes.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: charging-in-extreme-temperature history is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Time Spent Charging During Extreme Temperatures Below Boundary
fields.definition: Cumulative time the battery spent charging below the lower temperature boundary, in minutes.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: charging-in-extreme-temperature history is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Time Spent in Extreme Temperatures Above Boundary
fields.definition: Cumulative time the battery spent above the upper temperature boundary, in minutes.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: temperature-exposure history is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Time Spent in Extreme Temperatures Below Boundary
fields.definition: Cumulative time the battery spent below the lower temperature boundary, in minutes.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex VII Part B: temperature-exposure history is battery-individual usage data for the Art. 14 legitimate-interest audience.

fields.label: Transport Conditions
fields.definition: Description of transport conditions during the event.
fields.tier_rationale: Transport conditions during an excursion are condition-history detail of the Annex VII Part B record for the Art. 14 audience.

fields.label: Transportation Safety Class
fields.definition: UN transportation classification (e.g., UN3481, UN3480).
fields.tier_rationale: UN dangerous-goods classes (UN3480/UN3481) are printed on packages and shipping papers by transport law, so the passport only restates public markings (DIN DKE SPEC 99100 extension).

fields.label: Verification Body Name
fields.definition: Name of the verification body.
fields.tier_rationale: The verifier's name is part of the public verification statement backing the public CF declaration (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Verification Certificate URL
fields.definition: URL to the verification certificate document.
fields.tier_rationale: The verification certificate substantiates the public CF declaration and is public by function, like oec:thirdPartyAssurancesUrl.

fields.label: Verification Date
fields.definition: Date when third-party verification was completed.
fields.tier_rationale: The verification date qualifies the currency of the public verification statement (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Verification Standard
fields.definition: Standard used for verification (e.g., ISO 14064-3).
fields.tier_rationale: The standard the verifier applied is part of the public verification statement (Art. 7/Annex II).

fields.label: Warranty Conditions
fields.definition: URL to warranty terms and conditions. For warranty duration, use gs1:warranty.
fields.tier_rationale: Annex XIII(1)(m): the period of the commercial warranty for calendar life is public battery-passport data, and its terms address the purchaser.

fields.label: Waste Prevention
fields.definition: URL to waste prevention information.
fields.tier_rationale: Art. 74(1)(a)/Annex XIII(1)(s): waste-prevention information is directed at the general public.
